People's Majlis Committee Minutes

11th Meeting of the Environment and Climate Change Committee

10 August 2026

Meeting venue: People's Majlis (Committee Room 6)
Start time: 11:00

{Presiding: Committee Chair; Member for South Maafannu constituency, Abdulla Rifau}

The Chair said:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. I welcome everyone to the 11th meeting of the People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee. The meeting is being held in Committee Room 6. Today's date is 10 August, Monday. The time is 11:00. Today we have before us the amendment to Law No. 24/2022 (Waste Management Act) that was referred to us; we had studied it and passed it at the previous meeting. However, because a small change needs to be made to it, we have called this committee together again. Present at the committee today are: myself (Member for South Maafannu constituency, Abdulla Rifau), Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency Abdulla Shazeem, Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer, Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed Siruhaan, Member for South Thinadhoo constituency Mohamed Alsan Ahmed, and Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed. So, the issue that has come up is that Article 41 was sent to be amended. Establishing waste management centres. Article 41(a) states that any party may establish a waste management centre only in accordance with the standards set by the Ministry. (b) - A site for landfilling as part of waste management may be established only in accordance with the standards set by the Ministry. With the amendment worded like this, we noticed while rechecking it that the law as it currently stands says exactly the same thing, with no difference at all. If that is the case, this cannot be considered an amendment. So, amendment number 17, that is, removing number 17 from the bill before us, has now become our amendment. So, this needs to be proposed and taken forward in that way.

Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer said:
Thank you. Honourable Chair, as you just pointed out, the amendment sent to us today, in fact the 17th, the amendment proposed to Article 41(a) and (b), is an amendment identical to Article 41(a) and (b) of this law as it already stands, and so, clause for

[stamp]

clause, there is no difference here at all. Therefore, I propose that we remove the proposed amendment.

The Chair said:
Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim.

Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim said:
I second the proposal of the Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer.

The Chair said:
Thank you. A proposal has now been made by the Honourable Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer. Hassan Zareer's proposal is: the 17th amendment to the law before us is the amendment of Article 41 of the said law. However, since that too is no different in any way from how the law already stands, the proposal is to remove it. This proposal was seconded by the Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim. Therefore, I put this proposal to a vote for passage. (Voting) Thank you. With the unanimous agreement of the members present at today's committee, this proposal has been passed. So, next is the vote to pass the whole bill with this amendment. So, I call for a vote to pass the whole bill with this amendment. (Voting) Thank you. With the unanimous agreement of the members present at the committee at this time, this bill has been passed. Thank you. Therefore, today, the next task before us is amending the Utilities Bill. We set a deadline for this the other day as well. And we have given the relevant offices until today to send their comments on it. So, announcing that there will be a committee meeting tomorrow to take the work on that bill forward, I close today's committee meeting. Thank you very much.

[stamp]
